notes.title: Streamer! Your community will LOVE this new feature.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44111956/d62d6b0527b28ca6ddc1d4430a7bcd41af8460ca.png[/img]

Are you streaming on Twitch? Do you want to play with your community and share exclusive moments with them?
It's possible! One click, and your Twitch account connects to the game. Then, viewers can interact with the game through the chat.
It's fun and super easy to set up: Give it a try now!

Check out [url=https://www.twitch.tv/linkorep]Linkorep[/url] and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/wulfriktitus]Wulfriktitus[/url] testing out this amazing feature!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vxAG6XTH4NQ

notes.title: Meaningless original soundtrack is available!
notes.notes:
Surprise! The music from "Meaningless" is now available on the store page!

What could be better than relaxing or meditating after a hard day? This album will surely put you in a good mood!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44111956/e0b12fd6a254fbfd594d34e4fa1fec89fc136602.png[/img]

The entire original soundtrack of "Meaningless" is offered in an exclusive bundle, the "Ultra Golden Pack - Deluxe Edition," perfect for those who appreciate affordable luxury. And here's another piece of good news! (Yes, because at Duck Reaction, we love good news 😄) If you already own the game, you can still purchase the bundle at a discounted price! 🍾

Get your copy now and immerse yourself in the enchanting melodies of "Meaningless." Take a break, relax, and enjoy this highly satisfying experience! 🎶

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2412190/Meaningless/]Get the "Ultra Golden Pack - Deluxe Edition" here.[/url][/b]
